Chapter one

Our Love Story

♡

Our story did not begin with a grand plan. It began with a simple hello, and every day since has made us more sure that we were meant to walk this road together.

The First Hello

It started with a hello. We did not know it yet, but an ordinary day was quietly becoming the beginning of everything.

Growing Together

Little by little we became each other's best friend. Long talks, shared laughter and quiet evenings taught us that home is wherever the other one is.

The Proposal

One question, one happy yes, and a promise to build our life together, in good days and in hard ones.

Forever Begins

On 12 December 2026, in Kibuye, we will say "I do" surrounded by the family and friends who have loved us into this moment.

💌 A little love letter (tap to read)

To the one who made every ordinary day feel like a celebration: thank you for your patience, your laughter and your kind heart. With you I have learned what it means to be at peace. I cannot wait to call you my wife, my partner and my home.
Forever yours, Emery

With all our love · Emery & Aline
